verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS where scheduled reports or recurring syncs are a fair question, but the evidence shows no user-configurable recurring job or workflow scheduler. 'Automate ... workflows in bulk' describes one-off bulk actions, not a recurring schedule. 'Vesting schedules' are equity terms rather than job scheduling, and the API's changed-rows-since-last-request paging is only a building block a developer could poll on their own schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
